routed_weighted.request_interpretation: Observed replay execution only; no retrieval-efficiency or live-latency claim

routed_concat.request_interpretation: Observed replay execution only; no retrieval-efficiency or live-latency claim

all_concat.request_interpretation: Observed replay execution only; no retrieval-efficiency or live-latency claim

routed_rrf -> routed_weighted.request_claim_disabled: Fusion reuses prior retrieval; only answer-quality differences are comparable

routed_concat -> routed_weighted.request_claim_disabled: Fusion reuses prior retrieval; only answer-quality differences are comparable

all_concat -> fixed_all.request_claim_disabled: Fusion reuses prior retrieval; only answer-quality differences are comparable

complete_case_sensitivity.rule: Retain a question only if all four fixed-condition outcomes completed successfully; exclude the entire paired question otherwise.

interpretation.timing: Per-outcome times are descriptive. No claim of controlled speedup. Separate timing-repeat outputs are excluded.
interpretation.requests: Application data requests exclude control and Decisions calls. Replay conditions are not efficiency measurements.
interpretation.fusion: Successful routed fusion comparisons supplied identical reader contexts, so tied scores do not test different reader-visible evidence rankings.
interpretation.link_access: The fixed-policy graph increment is positive under masked PostgreSQL links. The interaction interval includes zero. Routed arm comparisons also change capability descriptions.
interpretation.scope: One experiment organized into sequential phases, with distinct question cohorts and original provenance retained. No pooled leaderboard score.
